commits.record: the commit that adds this file (final HEAD)

root_cause: Both project entry points used QtQuick.Dialogs FolderDialog (qml/NativeWorkspace.qml projectFolder, qml/Workspace.qml projectFolder). The installed wrapper forces QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=generic and QT_QUICK_CONTROLS_STYLE=Basic, so no native dialog exists and Qt's Quick fallback (quickimpl FolderDialog.qml) is used.
That fallback is a separate window with a hardcoded 600x400 background, 16 px icons and one-line delegate labels without width-aware wrapping or elision.

Backend::applyInterfaceFont applies the interface scale to QGuiApplication's font (13 px x 175 % = 23 px, 26 px at 200 %), which the stock dialog inherits. Text grows, the window does not: long folder names and the breadcrumb/path are cut off; on a phone-width window the 600 px chooser is wider than the screen.

implementation.choice: One shared app component, qml/ProjectFolderDialog.qml (a StudioDialog, so the app's theme, accent, focus ring and button box), with one instance in NativeWorkspace exposed as projectChooser; Main passes it to Workspace, whose chooseProjectFolder() opens it with Workspace's existing title. Folders are read by two small Backend invokables. No Qt private/quickimpl internals, system Qt files, platform theme, GTK/portal settings, global font or user zoom were touched; the 175 % font stays.
implementation.why_not_stock: FolderDialog's public API has no size, font or delegate control for the Quick fallback; a native dialog would need a different platform theme, which the wrapper deliberately forces to generic. A QtWidgets QFileDialog would add a widget application and still not follow the app's scale, theme or phone layout.

backend.resolveFolderPath(typed, base): absolute, cleaned (not symlink-resolved) path from typed/pasted text: ~ and ~/..., file: URLs (percent-decoded), paths relative to the shown folder, pasted line breaks dropped, empty = current folder
backend.folderListing(typed, base, hidden): {path, parent, home, error (missing|not-folder|unreadable), folders[{name, path, link, target}]}; folders only, QCollator numeric + case-insensitive order, dot-folders only with hidden, broken links and files left out, a symlink keeps its own path and names its canonical target
backend.choosing: Open/Ctrl+Enter go through the existing Backend::projectFolder (canonical path, .app bundles refused), the same rule as a dropped folder; recent projects therefore stay canonical

behaviour: Desktop: centred, min(window - 2 x 24 px scaled, 760 px scaled) x min(window - 2 x 24 px scaled, 640 px scaled); all lengths and fonts follow Theme (13 px body x scale).

Phone (NativeWorkspace.phone, width < 600 logical px): full-width sheet inside SafeArea and above the on-screen keyboard (NativeWorkspace insets), mobile type, 48 px x scale targets; parent/home become icon buttons (accessible names, tooltips) when the dialog is narrower than 440 px x scale.

Location: a wrapping, editable mono field that shows the whole path (up to three lines, fewer on short dialogs, scrolls beyond); left-to-right also in RTL; Enter shows the typed folder, Ctrl+Enter/Open chooses it; Open is disabled unless the location is a project-capable folder.

List: every name wraps (WrapAtWordBoundaryOrAnywhere), symlink rows show '→ target', the open project's folder is marked and current on open, the folder just left is current after going up; 'No folders here' or '<path> cannot be read.' when empty/unreadable.
Short windows: the body scrolls above the fixed Open/Cancel footer and the list always keeps two rows.

Keyboard: focus starts in the list; Ctrl+L location; Tab order location, parent, home, Hidden, list, Open, Cancel; Up/Down, Enter or Right opens a folder, Backspace/Left/Alt+Up goes up (mirrored in RTL); Esc or Cancel closes without changing the project; reopening always starts beside the open project.

limitations: Offscreen software rendering in an isolated session, not the user's Hyprland compositor or their live window; the user's exact original symptom was not confirmed beyond the reproduced scaling defect.
The other stock file/folder dialogs (see other_dialogs) still use Qt's fixed-width fallback at large interface sizes.

The chooser lists folders only and has no bookmarks/places sidebar or recent-folders list; the location field (typed or pasted path, ~/) covers other places. Very large folders are listed synchronously.
Hidden folders are hidden by default; Hidden shows them for the current chooser session only (not persisted).
No screen reader (Orca) run; accessible names and roles are checked by the tests.
tomaccoctl was not rebuilt (see tests.build); root's combined host and ARM64 checks remain to be run after integration.
No physical device, Pixel, ADB, SSH or network was used.
not_done_on_purpose: No change to the global font, interface scale, platform theme, Qt style, system Qt files, Qt private QML, GTK/portal settings, installed binaries/wrappers or user preferences; no push, release or install.
